methodology.firstScrollBoundary: first scroll input issued by this harness after startup observation and readiness wait
methodology.webkitNetworkCaveat: Throttled WebKit uses buffered route fulfillment and is approximate; it is not equivalent to physical Safari streaming.
methodology.physicalDeviceBoundary: Playwright WebKit on Windows is not iPhone Safari, iPhone Chrome, Android Chrome, or macOS Safari acceptance.

tti.method: legacy 5-second long-task quiet window; not Lighthouse TTI and not a hard cross-engine gate

tbt.method: sum of each long task's blocking portion after its first 50 ms, clipped to the FCP-to-TTI window

bytesBeforeFirstScroll.definition: sum of PerformanceResourceTiming.transferSize for completed requests before first harness scroll input
bytesBeforeFirstScroll.caveat: value is a lower-bound approximation because partial bytes from requests still in flight at the boundary are unavailable in Playwright WebKit; the started-request total is an eventual upper-bound diagnostic

total.definition: sum of long-task durations during the first 15 seconds

hiddenInViewport.definition: all hidden or opacity-zero non-aria-hidden elements intersecting the viewport
